context: Tests release verification and concrete JavaScript SDK migration reasoning, not memorization of a dated npm snapshot.

checklist.name: Verifies the target release before upgrading
checklist.description: Checks official release tags, target package versions and npm metadata. Does not infer a stable release from a planned date or recommend a development/canary build as production stable. Distinguishes main-branch migration plans from tagged release behavior.

checklist.name: Updates runtime and package requirements deliberately
checklist.description: Identifies the documented SDK 3.0 Node >=22.15.0 floor for application and CI, while preserving the API/semantic-conventions exceptions and checking each installed package's engines.

checklist.name: Migrates tracing initialization and processors
checklist.description: Plans consolidation into @opentelemetry/sdk-trace, TracerProvider, explicit provider/context-manager/propagator registration, and the processor options-object form with exporter. Does not drop context propagation when replacing register().

checklist.name: Preserves configuration and removes obsolete dependencies
checklist.description: Accounts for removed trace-SDK environment-variable fallbacks using explicit options or sdk-node. Checks the final migration guide for api-logs replacement and Jaeger-to-OTLP export instead of merely deleting imports.

checklist.name: Distinguishes API consumers from SDK-dependent instrumentation
checklist.description: Does not extend API compatibility guarantees to the custom instrumentation's SDK imports or patching internals. Requires review and tests of those dependencies.

checklist.name: Validates observable behavior before rollout
checklist.description: Proposes tests on the target minimum runtime for parent/child context propagation, exporter delivery, custom instrumentation patching, and shutdown flush. Keeps the existing deployment until those checks pass; compilation alone is insufficient.
